cohort: Pregnant women and their newborns admitted to two major hospitals in Crete between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2019.
finding: The GBS colonization rate among pregnant women in Crete was 1.7%, which is among the lowest globally reported, and universal screening combined with intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis effectively prevented neonatal GBS disease.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was analyzed but showed no significant association with GBS colonization.
